focus: 辨別保護電流、電位量測與地下金屬腐蝕的證據鏈~Distinguish protective current, potential measurements and evidence of underground metal corrosion

units.anchor: 閉合電流迴路~Closed current circuit
units.title: 閉合電流迴路~Closed current circuit
units.mechanism: 陰極防蝕需要金屬連接與電解質路徑共同閉合，電源有電壓不代表被保護金屬收到所需電流。歐姆模型只說明等效迴路，電極極化與接觸阻抗會使現場偏離常數電阻。假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。~Cathodic protection needs both metallic and electrolyte paths to close the circuit. Supply voltage alone does not establish current reaching the protected metal. An Ohmic model describes an equivalent circuit; polarization and contact impedance can make field resistance variable. For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time. A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time.
units.verify: 以經校正的電流量測與接線圖核對迴路連續性，分別記錄電源輸出、測點電位及環境條件。確認測試不改變相鄰設施的保護狀態，操作由合格防蝕人員執行。同時排除以下干擾原因：接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。~Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately. Qualified corrosion personnel must verify that testing does not compromise neighbouring protection systems. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection.
units.failure: 接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。~A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection.
units.misconception: 只要閉合電流迴路符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for closed current circuit removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接閉合電流迴路時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以經校正的電流量測與接線圖核對迴路連續性，分別記錄電源輸出、測點電位及環境條件。確認測試不改變相鄰設施的保護狀態，操作由合格防蝕人員執行。~When handing over closed current circuit, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately. Qualified corrosion personnel must verify that testing does not compromise neighbouring protection systems.

units.anchor: 塗層缺陷電流需求~Current demand at coating defects
units.title: 塗層缺陷電流需求~Current demand at coating defects
units.mechanism: 完整塗層減少與土壤接觸的面積，保護電流主要流向缺陷及裸露部位。缺陷面積比例與所需電流密度均需有證據，不能只用總金屬面積推估相同的需求。假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。~Sound coating reduces soil-exposed area, concentrating protection current at holidays and bare surfaces. Both defect fraction and required current density need evidence rather than assuming identical demand over the entire metal surface. For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A. Shielding and uneven distribution are excluded. Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A. Shielding and uneven distribution are excluded.
units.verify: 核對塗層檢查、施工損傷與接頭修補紀錄，將估計缺陷面積和現地電流需求比較。用多測點電位判斷分布，電流總量相符不能代替每個控制位置的驗證。同時排除以下干擾原因：剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。~Review coating inspections, installation damage and joint repairs, comparing estimated defect area with measured demand. Multiple potential readings establish distribution; matching total current does not verify every controlling location. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area.
units.failure: 剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。~Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area.
units.misconception: 只要塗層缺陷電流需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接塗層缺陷電流需求時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對塗層檢查、施工損傷與接頭修補紀錄，將估計缺陷面積和現地電流需求比較。用多測點電位判斷分布，電流總量相符不能代替每個控制位置的驗證。~When handing over current demand at coating defects, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review coating inspections, installation damage and joint repairs, comparing estimated defect area with measured demand. Multiple potential readings establish distribution; matching total current does not verify every controlling location.

units.anchor: 土壤視電阻率~Apparent soil resistivity
units.title: 土壤視電阻率~Apparent soil resistivity
units.mechanism: 土壤電阻率影響電流分布，但與含水、鹽分及分層共同變化，單一數字不能直接換成腐蝕速率。Wenner模型需均質半空間與等間距，測得結果應依幾何稱為視電阻率。等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。地下管線或接地網可改變電流路徑，使視電阻率偏離原狀土壤；若直接用此值決定陽極配置，可能形成不均勻保護而且難以解釋後續量測。~Soil resistivity influences current distribution but varies with moisture, salts and layering, so one value is not a corrosion rate. The Wenner model assumes a homogeneous half-space and equal spacing; field results are apparent resistivity for the measurement geometry. For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m. Layering or deep electrodes requires correction. Buried pipes or grounding grids can distort current paths and apparent resistivity. Designing anode distribution directly from that value may create uneven protection and confusing later measurements.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m. Layering or deep electrodes requires correction.
units.verify: 使用合適電阻率儀器記錄間距、埋深、地表狀態及附近金屬，改變方向與尺度檢查一致性。若差異顯著，應用分層解釋與補充調查而非挑最有利讀值。同時排除以下干擾原因：地下管線或接地網可改變電流路徑，使視電阻率偏離原狀土壤；若直接用此值決定陽極配置，可能形成不均勻保護而且難以解釋後續量測。~Record spacing, electrode depth, surface conditions and nearby metal using suitable instrumentation. Vary direction and scale to test consistency; significant differences call for layered interpretation and further investigation rather than selecting a favourable reading. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Buried pipes or grounding grids can distort current paths and apparent resistivity. Designing anode distribution directly from that value may create uneven protection and confusing later measurements.
units.failure: 地下管線或接地網可改變電流路徑，使視電阻率偏離原狀土壤；若直接用此值決定陽極配置，可能形成不均勻保護而且難以解釋後續量測。~Buried pipes or grounding grids can distort current paths and apparent resistivity. Designing anode distribution directly from that value may create uneven protection and confusing later measurements.
units.misconception: 只要土壤視電阻率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for apparent soil resistivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接土壤視電阻率時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。使用合適電阻率儀器記錄間距、埋深、地表狀態及附近金屬，改變方向與尺度檢查一致性。若差異顯著，應用分層解釋與補充調查而非挑最有利讀值。~When handing over apparent soil resistivity, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Record spacing, electrode depth, surface conditions and nearby metal using suitable instrumentation. Vary direction and scale to test consistency; significant differences call for layered interpretation and further investigation rather than selecting a favourable reading.

units.anchor: 犧牲陽極壽命~Sacrificial anode life
units.title: 犧牲陽極壽命~Sacrificial anode life
units.mechanism: 犧牲陽極可提供的總電量受材料質量與有效電容量限制，還要保留不能完全利用的殘餘部分。有效電容量若已包含電化學效率，不可再次乘同一效率而重複折減。假設M=20kg、Ceff=780Ah/kg已含電化學效率、材料利用率u=0.85、I=0.20A，L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years。若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。~Available sacrificial-anode charge depends on mass and effective capacity, with a residual fraction that cannot be fully used. If effective capacity already includes electrochemical efficiency, applying that efficiency again would double count the reduction. With M=20kg, Ceff=780Ah/kg already including electrochemical efficiency, material utilization u=0.85 and I=0.20A, L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years. Ageing coating can raise demand while a failed connection leaves nominal anode mass unable to protect. Calendar-only maintenance misses abnormal current distribution or accelerated consumption.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設M=20kg、Ceff=780Ah/kg已含電化學效率、材料利用率u=0.85、I=0.20A，L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With M=20kg, Ceff=780Ah/kg already including electrochemical efficiency, material utilization u=0.85 and I=0.20A, L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years.
units.verify: 查驗陽極材質、電容量定義及質量證明，將電流需求的時間變化納入估算。以可追溯的檢查與量測確認消耗趨勢，不能把定電流理想壽命直接作更換保證。同時排除以下干擾原因：若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。~Verify material, capacity definition and mass certificates, accounting for demand variation over time. Traceable inspection and measurements should check consumption trends; the constant-current estimate is not a guaranteed replacement interval. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Ageing coating can raise demand while a failed connection leaves nominal anode mass unable to protect. Calendar-only maintenance misses abnormal current distribution or accelerated consumption.
units.failure: 若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。~Ageing coating can raise demand while a failed connection leaves nominal anode mass unable to protect. Calendar-only maintenance misses abnormal current distribution or accelerated consumption.
units.misconception: 只要犧牲陽極壽命符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for sacrificial anode life removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

Verify material, capacity definition and mass certificates, accounting for demand variation over time. Traceable inspection and measurements should check consumption trends; the constant-current estimate is not a guaranteed replacement interval.

units.anchor: 整流器輸出功率~Rectifier output power
units.title: 整流器輸出功率~Rectifier output power
units.mechanism: 外加電流系統的直流輸出功率和市電耗能不同，整流器及線路會有損失。功率是運行記錄之一，保護是否有效仍須看結構電位與電流分布，不能由瓦數判定。假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。輸出下降可能是電源故障，也可能是迴路電阻上升；只把旋鈕調高而未查故障，會掩蓋壞接點並使其發熱，卻不一定改善最遠測點的保護。~Impressed-current DC output differs from mains energy because rectifiers and cables lose power. Output is useful operational evidence, but protection effectiveness depends on structure potentials and current distribution rather than wattage alone. For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W. This is terminal output power, excluding rectifier efficiency and AC input power factor. Falling output may mean supply failure or rising circuit resistance. Increasing the setting without diagnosis can heat a bad connection while leaving the most remote location insufficiently protected.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W. This is terminal output power, excluding rectifier efficiency and AC input power factor.
units.verify: 比對經校正的輸出電壓與電流，另外量測輸入耗能，保留時間及設定紀錄。輸出突然變化應與土壤含水、接線與結構電位一起分析，由防蝕工程師核定調整。同時排除以下干擾原因：輸出下降可能是電源故障，也可能是迴路電阻上升；只把旋鈕調高而未查故障，會掩蓋壞接點並使其發熱，卻不一定改善最遠測點的保護。~Check calibrated output voltage and current, measure input energy separately and retain times and settings. Interpret sudden changes alongside soil moisture, wiring and structure potential before a corrosion engineer approves adjustments. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Falling output may mean supply failure or rising circuit resistance. Increasing the setting without diagnosis can heat a bad connection while leaving the most remote location insufficiently protected.
units.failure: 輸出下降可能是電源故障，也可能是迴路電阻上升；只把旋鈕調高而未查故障，會掩蓋壞接點並使其發熱，卻不一定改善最遠測點的保護。~Falling output may mean supply failure or rising circuit resistance. Increasing the setting without diagnosis can heat a bad connection while leaving the most remote location insufficiently protected.
units.misconception: 只要整流器輸出功率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for rectifier output power removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接整流器輸出功率時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比對經校正的輸出電壓與電流，另外量測輸入耗能，保留時間及設定紀錄。輸出突然變化應與土壤含水、接線與結構電位一起分析，由防蝕工程師核定調整。~When handing over rectifier output power, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check calibrated output voltage and current, measure input energy separately and retain times and settings. Interpret sudden changes alongside soil moisture, wiring and structure potential before a corrosion engineer approves adjustments.

units.anchor: 電阻壓降與極化~Ohmic drop and polarization
units.title: 電阻壓降與極化~Ohmic drop and polarization
units.mechanism: 結構對電解質的量測電位可能包含土壤中的電阻壓降，不能把通電時的讀值直接等同界面極化。參考電極種類、位置與切換時序決定量測意義，須完整記錄。若量測路徑電流I=0.20A、等效土壤路徑R=2Ω，IRdrop=0.40V；此項不是金屬極化電位，也不是可通用扣除的常數。如果參考電極太靠近陽極，局部電位梯度可能讓結果顯得保護充足；把這種讀值當金屬表面狀態，會忽略遠處缺陷處仍有腐蝕的風險。~A structure-to-electrolyte reading can include soil Ohmic drop and is not automatically the interfacial polarization. Reference-electrode type, placement and switching timing determine its meaning and must be documented. For path current I=0.20A and equivalent soil-path R=2Ω, IRdrop=0.40V. This is not metal polarization potential or a universally removable constant. An electrode close to an anode may read a strong local gradient that suggests adequate protection. Interpreting it as the metal-surface condition can miss ongoing corrosion at remote defects.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：若量測路徑電流I=0.20A、等效土壤路徑R=2Ω，IRdrop=0.40V；此項不是金屬極化電位，也不是可通用扣除的常數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For path current I=0.20A and equivalent soil-path R=2Ω, IRdrop=0.40V. This is not metal polarization potential or a universally removable constant.
units.verify: 以合適參考電極與同步量測程序區分通電壓降和極化反應，核對電極狀態、接觸及時間戳。有效性判定採適用標準及工程師核准條件，不提供單一跨材質門檻。同時排除以下干擾原因：如果參考電極太靠近陽極，局部電位梯度可能讓結果顯得保護充足；把這種讀值當金屬表面狀態，會忽略遠處缺陷處仍有腐蝕的風險。~Use an appropriate reference electrode and synchronized procedure to separate Ohmic and polarization effects, checking electrode condition, contact and timestamps. Apply relevant standards and approved conditions rather than one threshold across all materials. Also rule out the following competing explanation: An electrode close to an anode may read a strong local gradient that suggests adequate protection. Interpreting it as the metal-surface condition can miss ongoing corrosion at remote defects.

Use an appropriate reference electrode and synchronized procedure to separate Ohmic and polarization effects, checking electrode condition, contact and timestamps. Apply relevant standards and approved conditions rather than one threshold across all materials.

units.anchor: 雜散電流電量~Stray current charge
units.title: 雜散電流電量~Stray current charge
units.mechanism: 雜散直流在金屬離開的位置可造成局部腐蝕，其方向與持續時間比單次瞬時值更重要。電量積分描述通過多少電荷，金屬損失還需電化學反應與電流效率。假設同方向雜散電流I=0.10A持續t=3600s，Q=It=360C；正負交替需分方向積分，不可只用帶符號淨值推估局部腐蝕。正負電流平均接近零仍可在不同位置造成金屬溶解；忽略時序會將尖峰干擾當儀器噪聲，直到局部穿孔才發現累積的腐蝕後果。~Stray DC can corrode metal where it leaves the structure. Direction and duration matter beyond an instantaneous reading. Integrating charge quantifies transferred electricity, while metal loss also requires reaction stoichiometry and current efficiency. For same-direction stray current I=0.10A over t=3600s, Q=It=360C. Alternating directions need separate integration; signed net charge alone cannot estimate local corrosion. Near-zero average current can still dissolve metal at different locations. Ignoring timing may dismiss interference peaks as noise until accumulated local corrosion causes perforation.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同方向雜散電流I=0.10A持續t=3600s，Q=It=360C；正負交替需分方向積分，不可只用帶符號淨值推估局部腐蝕。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For same-direction stray current I=0.10A over t=3600s, Q=It=360C. Alternating directions need separate integration; signed net charge alone cannot estimate local corrosion.
units.verify: 同步記錄管地電位、電流方向與鄰近牽引或工業運轉時序，辨別重複干擾。由相關設施的防蝕負責人協調測試，保留各方基準而不是單方面改接線。同時排除以下干擾原因：正負電流平均接近零仍可在不同位置造成金屬溶解；忽略時序會將尖峰干擾當儀器噪聲，直到局部穿孔才發現累積的腐蝕後果。~Synchronize pipe potentials and current direction with nearby traction or industrial operating cycles. Corrosion leads for all affected facilities should coordinate tests and preserve baseline conditions rather than modifying connections unilaterally. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Near-zero average current can still dissolve metal at different locations. Ignoring timing may dismiss interference peaks as noise until accumulated local corrosion causes perforation.
units.failure: 正負電流平均接近零仍可在不同位置造成金屬溶解；忽略時序會將尖峰干擾當儀器噪聲，直到局部穿孔才發現累積的腐蝕後果。~Near-zero average current can still dissolve metal at different locations. Ignoring timing may dismiss interference peaks as noise until accumulated local corrosion causes perforation.
units.misconception: 只要雜散電流電量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for stray current charge removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接雜散電流電量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。同步記錄管地電位、電流方向與鄰近牽引或工業運轉時序，辨別重複干擾。由相關設施的防蝕負責人協調測試，保留各方基準而不是單方面改接線。~When handing over stray current charge, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Synchronize pipe potentials and current direction with nearby traction or industrial operating cycles. Corrosion leads for all affected facilities should coordinate tests and preserve baseline conditions rather than modifying connections unilaterally.

units.anchor: 絕緣旁路電流~Insulation bypass current
units.title: 絕緣旁路電流~Insulation bypass current
units.mechanism: 絕緣接頭用於控制電流路徑，但接地、儀器或金屬支承可能形成旁路。旁路既可耗用保護電流，也可能影響其他系統，任何改動需兼顧電氣安全與防蝕設計。假設旁路兩端V=1V、R=5Ω，Ibypass=V/R=0.20A；此電流未必到達需要保護的裸露金屬，不可全部計作有效保護。臨時儀器屏蔽線或支承跨接可讓原本分開的系統重新連通，造成輸出增加及相鄰設施干擾；只查主要接頭會漏掉這些不易看見的旁路。~Insulating joints control current paths, but grounding, instruments and metal supports can bypass them. A bypass consumes protective current and may affect other systems, so changes must respect both electrical safety and corrosion design. For V=1V across bypass R=5Ω, Ibypass=V/R=0.20A. It may not reach exposed metal needing protection and cannot all be credited as effective current. Temporary instrument shields or supports can reconnect isolated systems, increasing output and interference. Inspecting only the main joint can miss these less visible bypass paths.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設旁路兩端V=1V、R=5Ω，Ibypass=V/R=0.20A；此電流未必到達需要保護的裸露金屬，不可全部計作有效保護。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For V=1V across bypass R=5Ω, Ibypass=V/R=0.20A. It may not reach exposed metal needing protection and cannot all be credited as effective current.
units.verify: 依竣工圖辨識所有可能跨接，使用核准檢查方法量測絕緣與連續性，對照正常運轉電位。不得為改善防蝕而任意拆除保護接地，修改須經電氣及防蝕工程師共同審查。同時排除以下干擾原因：臨時儀器屏蔽線或支承跨接可讓原本分開的系統重新連通，造成輸出增加及相鄰設施干擾；只查主要接頭會漏掉這些不易看見的旁路。~Identify possible bridges from as-built drawings and use approved checks of insulation and continuity against operating potentials. Never remove protective grounding merely to improve corrosion readings; electrical and corrosion engineers jointly review changes. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Temporary instrument shields or supports can reconnect isolated systems, increasing output and interference. Inspecting only the main joint can miss these less visible bypass paths.
units.failure: 臨時儀器屏蔽線或支承跨接可讓原本分開的系統重新連通，造成輸出增加及相鄰設施干擾；只查主要接頭會漏掉這些不易看見的旁路。~Temporary instrument shields or supports can reconnect isolated systems, increasing output and interference. Inspecting only the main joint can miss these less visible bypass paths.
units.misconception: 只要絕緣旁路電流符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for insulation bypass current removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接絕緣旁路電流時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。依竣工圖辨識所有可能跨接，使用核准檢查方法量測絕緣與連續性，對照正常運轉電位。不得為改善防蝕而任意拆除保護接地，修改須經電氣及防蝕工程師共同審查。~When handing over insulation bypass current, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Identify possible bridges from as-built drawings and use approved checks of insulation and continuity against operating potentials. Never remove protective grounding merely to improve corrosion readings; electrical and corrosion engineers jointly review changes.

units.anchor: 需求變化趨勢~Current demand trend
units.title: 需求變化趨勢~Current demand trend
units.mechanism: 維護期電流增加可能來自塗層損傷、土壤變濕或短路，不應直接視為保護更好。趨勢判讀需要相同電位目標與可比較的環境，將需求變化和供電設定分開。假設可比較工況需求由0.20A升到0.60A，比值Inew/Iold=3；此三倍僅表示需求變化，不表示防蝕能力或安全程度提高三倍。若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。~Higher operating current may reflect damaged coating, wetter soil or a short, rather than improved protection. Trend analysis needs comparable potential targets and environmental conditions, separating demand changes from deliberate supply adjustments. If comparable demand rises from0.20A to0.60A, Inew/Iold=3. This describes demand, not a tripling of protection effectiveness or safety. Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained. Higher output may also worsen local overprotection, producing acceptable-looking readings while durability declines.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較工況需求由0.20A升到0.60A，比值Inew/Iold=3；此三倍僅表示需求變化，不表示防蝕能力或安全程度提高三倍。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If comparable demand rises from0.20A to0.60A, Inew/Iold=3. This describes demand, not a tripling of protection effectiveness or safety.
units.verify: 並排比較輸出、各測點電位、季節土壤狀態與維修事件，再決定是否需要塗層調查或接線檢查。對突然變化建立有責任人的異常單，避免只重設趨勢基線。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。~Compare output, test-point potentials, seasonal ground conditions and repairs before deciding on coating or wiring investigation. Assign responsibility for abrupt changes rather than simply resetting the trend baseline. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained. Higher output may also worsen local overprotection, producing acceptable-looking readings while durability declines.
units.failure: 若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。~Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained. Higher output may also worsen local overprotection, producing acceptable-looking readings while durability declines.
units.misconception: 只要需求變化趨勢符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for current demand trend removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接需求變化趨勢時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。並排比較輸出、各測點電位、季節土壤狀態與維修事件，再決定是否需要塗層調查或接線檢查。對突然變化建立有責任人的異常單，避免只重設趨勢基線。~When handing over current demand trend, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare output, test-point potentials, seasonal ground conditions and repairs before deciding on coating or wiring investigation. Assign responsibility for abrupt changes rather than simply resetting the trend baseline.

units.anchor: 年度電量與交接~Annual charge and handover
units.title: 年度電量與交接~Annual charge and handover
units.mechanism: 年度累積電量支援陽極消耗與運轉比較，但缺測、停機及變動電流都會影響積分。電量不能代替有效電位紀錄，交接要連結儀表、位置、維護與異常處理的證據。假設非閏年8760h內I=0.20A恆定，Qyear=I×8760h=1752Ah；這是一年累積電量，若稱年度率才寫1752Ah/year。若把全年最大電流乘上總時數會高估消耗，忽略停機卻可能掩蓋保護中斷；單一年度總量無法分辨長時間低電流與短暫高電流的不同腐蝕風險。~Annual accumulated charge supports anode-consumption and operating comparisons, but gaps, outages and changing current affect integration. Charge does not replace valid potential records; handover links instruments, locations, maintenance and resolved anomalies. For constant I=0.20A over a nonleap year of8760h, Qyear=1752Ah. This is accumulated annual charge;1752Ah/year denotes an annual rate instead. Multiplying peak current by the full year overestimates consumption, while ignoring outages conceals protection loss. One annual total cannot distinguish different corrosion risks from prolonged low current and brief high current.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設非閏年8760h內I=0.20A恆定，Qyear=I×8760h=1752Ah；這是一年累積電量，若稱年度率才寫1752Ah/year。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For constant I=0.20A over a nonleap year of8760h, Qyear=1752Ah. This is accumulated annual charge;1752Ah/year denotes an annual rate instead.
units.verify: 用原始時間序列分段積分並標記缺測，和陽極質量、有效電容量及定期電位檢測交叉比較。交接需附校正、參考電極類型及警報責任，缺失由防蝕主管結案。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把全年最大電流乘上總時數會高估消耗，忽略停機卻可能掩蓋保護中斷；單一年度總量無法分辨長時間低電流與短暫高電流的不同腐蝕風險。~Integrate the original time series by intervals and mark gaps, comparing with anode mass, effective capacity and periodic potential surveys. Handover includes calibration, electrode type and alarm ownership, with gaps closed by the corrosion lead. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Multiplying peak current by the full year overestimates consumption, while ignoring outages conceals protection loss. One annual total cannot distinguish different corrosion risks from prolonged low current and brief high current.
units.failure: 若把全年最大電流乘上總時數會高估消耗，忽略停機卻可能掩蓋保護中斷；單一年度總量無法分辨長時間低電流與短暫高電流的不同腐蝕風險。~Multiplying peak current by the full year overestimates consumption, while ignoring outages conceals protection loss. One annual total cannot distinguish different corrosion risks from prolonged low current and brief high current.
units.misconception: 只要年度電量與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for annual charge and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接年度電量與交接時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用原始時間序列分段積分並標記缺測，和陽極質量、有效電容量及定期電位檢測交叉比較。交接需附校正、參考電極類型及警報責任，缺失由防蝕主管結案。~When handing over annual charge and handover, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Integrate the original time series by intervals and mark gaps, comparing with anode mass, effective capacity and periodic potential surveys. Handover includes calibration, electrode type and alarm ownership, with gaps closed by the corrosion lead.

title: 地下結構陰極防蝕~Cathodic protection of underground structures
summary: 本課聚焦辨別保護電流、電位量測與地下金屬腐蝕的證據鏈。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。~This course focuses on distinguish protective current, potential measurements and evidence of underground metal corrosion. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
example: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。假設有效電壓由2V增加10%至2.2V且R固定10Ω，電流由0.20升為0.22A，增加0.02A；現地極化、含水與接觸阻抗可能改變R，故不能據此授權提高電源設定。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。~The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time. Increasing assumed effective voltage from2V to2.2V by10% at fixed R=10Ω raises current from0.20 to0.22A, a0.02A increase. Field polarization, moisture and contact impedance may alter R, so this does not authorize changing supply settings. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
history: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立辨別保護電流、電位量測與地下金屬腐蝕的證據鏈的背景。Bankhead船閘電位調查出現在官方手冊案例（2014）。美國設施設計準則出版陰極防蝕歷史版本（2016）。美國工兵團發布土建結構陰極防蝕手冊版本（2021）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。~This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for distinguish protective current, potential measurements and evidence of underground metal corrosion. A Bankhead potential survey appears in the official manual example (2014). US facilities criteria publish a historical cathodic-protection edition (2016). USACE issues an edition of its civil-works cathodic-protection manual (2021). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A. Shielding and uneven distribution are excluded.

教學假設，非現場設定值：等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m. Layering or deep electrodes requires correction.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設M=20kg、Ceff=780Ah/kg已含電化學效率、材料利用率u=0.85、I=0.20A，L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With M=20kg, Ceff=780Ah/kg already including electrochemical efficiency, material utilization u=0.85 and I=0.20A, L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W. This is terminal output power, excluding rectifier efficiency and AC input power factor.

教學假設，非現場設定值：若量測路徑電流I=0.20A、等效土壤路徑R=2Ω，IRdrop=0.40V；此項不是金屬極化電位，也不是可通用扣除的常數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For path current I=0.20A and equivalent soil-path R=2Ω, IRdrop=0.40V. This is not metal polarization potential or a universally removable constant.
